Noah (CS): Quick ask — enterprise tenant 'atlas-edge' goes live in 6h. Need a 6-item CSM micro-runbook (copy/pasteable) covering: prefill, warm pools, jitter, batching hints, streaming fallback, and a single renewal_risk rule. Keep it super short.
Leah (Solutions): I'll draft. Suggest 6 checkboxes + three code snippets (curl, JS, minimal telemetry).
Omar (SRE): Infra checklist (will own): 1) GET /healthz?tenant=atlas-edge -> 200 2) warm pool enabled for 45m 3) run 3 prefill probes -> success 4) set jitter policy (base=80ms + rand(0..140ms)) 5) enable KV cache reuse.
Noah (CS): Add a note: "Do not prefill > 700 tokens per user" and mark samples as staging/prod.
Leah (Solutions): Curl prefill snippet (copyable):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"tenant":"atlas-edge","samples":["Hi","Show recent invoices"]}'
```
Leah (Solutions): Tiny JS client:```js
fetch('/v1/prefill',{method:'POST',headers:{'Authorization':'Bearer K'},body:JSON.stringify({tenant:'atlas-edge',samples:['hi']})})
```
Jess (PM): Renewal_risk mapping (one-liner): high if any -> 7d latency P95 > 400ms OR 1h errors >1% OR any negative feedback within 48h. medium if a single marginal breach. else low. Wire cs-bot DM on high.
Noah (CS): Streaming fallback rule?
Omar (SRE): If streaming aborts within first 7s, retry as sync generate with max_tokens=200 and header `X-Redwood-Fallback:stream->sync`. Log event `fallback_type=stream_sync`.
Leah (Solutions): Batching guidance: interactive UI -> target batch=4-8; background jobs -> 16-64. If tail latency > target, flip to emergency small-batch: batch=2 + kv_cache=true.
Leah (Solutions): Telemetry sample (one-line JSON we recommend): {"event":"prefill","tenant":"atlas-edge","account_risk":"low","tokens":42,"latency_ms":118,"survey_sent":false}
Noah (CS): Perfect. I'll make a one-pager with 6 checkboxes and paste it into kickoff email.
Omar (SRE): I'll add the healthcheck script to ops repo and create cs-bot alert rule. ETA 3h.
Leah (Solutions): I'll publish the snippets to /docs/cs/micro-runbooks and link them here. ETA 2h.
cs-bot: Alert rule created  will DM @Noah when renewal_risk==high.
Noah (CS): Thanks all. Ping me if any drift. :white_check_mark:
